meta.positionPolicy: The 16 user points are retained as supplied, with unverified CRS. Oriental Pearl uses cached WGS84 OSM outline centroid. Existing-place identity does not certify a source-model mesh match or future operational state.
meta.licence: OSM geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL; public factual references linked per site.
meta.landmarksNotAllTransmitters: Cultural and public sites may be depicted as information-service endpoints, not automatically radio towers or telecom exchanges.
meta.modelPolicy: Existing recognisable silhouettes plus three user-approved authored 2050 concepts; source photos guide architecture, never surveyed dimensions.

landmarks.noteZh: 2026年6月竣工、2026-10-17正式启幕；艺术节官网地址浦东咏展路1号。不能再当2050才有的未建项目。给定坐标位置未另行测绘核验。 定位沿用用户给定经纬度，未声明坐标系；目前按WGS84进行艺术场景配准。
landmarks.noteEn: Completed in June 2026 and officially opened on 17 October 2026. Position follows user-provided coordinates; CRS was not declared and WGS84 is assumed for artwork placement, not survey certification.

landmarks.noteZh: 一期2021年底已开业；2026-06官方报道二期仍装修，预计2027年底开业，计划不是建成事实。 定位沿用用户给定经纬度，未声明坐标系；目前按WGS84进行艺术场景配准。
landmarks.noteEn: Phase 1 has operated since late 2021; the announced 2027 opening of phase 2 remains a plan. Position follows user-provided coordinates; CRS was not declared and WGS84 is assumed for artwork placement, not survey certification.

landmarks.noteZh: 2024年9月已开业，2026不是未建项目；为片区型滨水商业文化场所。 定位沿用用户给定经纬度，未声明坐标系；目前按WGS84进行艺术场景配准。

landmarks.noteEn: User-approved 2050 ecological atrium, with a central tree, ecological island, ring walks and a transparent enclosure. This is an authored future place, not a certified existing greenhouse project.

landmarks.noteZh: 滴水湖为真实地点；银白建筑采用用户确认的2050滨湖公共建筑概念：开孔低展屋盖、球冠、玻璃基座与公共平台。沿用作品锚点展示，不认证现实湖岸地块或已公布建设计划。
landmarks.noteEn: Dishui Lake is an existing place; its silver architecture is the user-approved 2050 lakeside public-building concept, with an open low roof, oculi, a spherical pavilion and terraces. Its artwork anchor does not certify a real shoreline parcel or approved development.

landmarks.noteZh: 既有历史会址；与2021开放的新馆属于纪念馆整体中的不同空间，不能把新馆当旧址同一建筑。 定位沿用用户给定经纬度，未声明坐标系；目前按WGS84进行艺术场景配准。
landmarks.noteEn: Existing historic congress site; distinguish it from the newer museum building. Position follows user-provided coordinates; CRS was not declared and WGS84 is assumed for artwork placement, not survey certification.

landmarks.noteZh: 现存广播电视塔。位置取自本地OSM way 40778038轮廓的面积重心；避免沿用旧界面的GCJ坐标近似。它提供公开广播角色锚点，艺术传播线不等于真实射频路径、带宽或2050网络实测。
landmarks.noteEn: Existing broadcasting tower. Position is the area centroid of cached OSM way 40778038, avoiding the legacy GCJ-like anchor. Its public broadcast role anchors authored connections, not measured radio paths, bandwidth or a 2050 network feed.
